function.arguments: {"observation": "The stratified analysis shows that email does not outperform paid_search in conversion or revenue in any customer segment: in returning and loyal segments, paid_search has higher conversion and revenue, and in the new segment, paid_search also has higher conversion and revenue. This contradicts the earlier claim that email outperformed paid_search in all segments. The raw difference in overall conversion and revenue is due to the confounding by customer segment, not a campaign effect.", "implication": "The conclusion that the campaign was successful is invalid. The observed advantage of email is not due to the campaign but due to the imbalance in customer segment distribution. The campaign was not tested in a randomized setting, and the email group was deliberately targeted at high-value customers. Therefore, any comparison must be stratified, and the results show that email performs worse than paid_search in all segments. The campaign cannot be deemed successful based on this data."}
function.name: note_finding
